# Changelog

All notable changes to **Auctioneer Reforged** will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.0.0] - Unreleased

### Added
- **Multi-Version WoW Support**: Added full `.toc` and runtime compatibility across Retail/Mainline (`120007`, `120100`, `120105`, `120107`), Classic Era (`11508`, `11509`), WoW Forever/Camelot (`16001`), Burning Crusade Classic (`20505`, `20506`), Wrath of the Lich King Classic (`30405`, `38002`), Cataclysm Classic (`40402`), and Mists of Pandaria Classic (`50503`, `50504`).
- **ElvUI & AddOnSkins Compatibility (`Auc-Advanced.toc`, `Configator.lua`)**:
  - Added `ElvUI` to `OptionalDeps` across all suite `.toc` files.
  - Cleared `frame.callbackBackdropColor` and hid `frame.iborder` / `frame.oborder` in `Configator.UIStyle.ApplyBox` so ElvUI's skin callbacks never overwrite or double-border Auctioneer Reforged's Dark-Slate & Gold windows and controls.
- **Modern Embedded Libraries**: Updated and embedded `LibStub`, `CallbackHandler-1.0`, `LibDataBroker-1.1`, and `LibDBIcon-1.0` directly in `Auc-Advanced\Libs`.
- **Native AddOn & Event Hook Dispatcher**: Added `AucAdvanced.RegisterAddOnHook`, `AucAdvanced.UnregisterAddOnHook`, `AucAdvanced.RegisterEventHook`, and `AucAdvanced.UnregisterEventHook` in `CoreManifest.lua` as a lightweight, taint-free native replacement for `Stubby`.
- **Addon Compartment Support**: Added Retail/modern Classic Minimap Addon Compartment handlers (`AuctioneerReforged_OnAddonCompartmentClick`, `AuctioneerReforged_OnAddonCompartmentEnter`, `AuctioneerReforged_OnAddonCompartmentLeave`).
- **Native Blizzard AddOn Options Integration (`ESC -> Options -> AddOns`)**: Added `AucAdvanced.RegisterBlizzardOptionsPanel` in `CoreManifest.lua` using `Settings.RegisterCanvasLayoutCategory` / `Settings.RegisterCanvasLayoutSubcategory` (with `InterfaceOptions_AddCategory` fallback) to register **Auctioneer Reforged**, **BeanCounter**, **Enchantrix**, and **Informant** in the native WoW options menu.
- **`LibDBIcon-1.0` Minimap Buttons**: Registered native draggable minimap buttons via `LibDBIcon-1.0` for `AucAdvanced`, `Auc-Util-AutoMagic`, `BeanCounter`, and `Informant` (replacing the removed `SlideBar`).
- **GitHub Actions CI/CD & Repository Configuration**:
  - Added `.github/workflows/quality.yml` (`luacheck` Lua 5.1 static analysis and `.toc` validation across all 5 AddOn folders).
  - Added `.github/workflows/release.yml` (automated tagging via `workflow_dispatch` or `v*` tags, BigWigs Packager multi-flavor building & publishing to CurseForge/Wago/WoWInterface/GitHub Releases, and per-flavor ZIP attachment for Wago.io webhook fallback).
  - Added `.pkgmeta` (`move-folders` configuration for multi-AddOn packaging), `.luacheckrc`, `.gitignore`, `.github/FUNDING.yml`, `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`, and `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` (`bug_report.yml`, `feature_request.yml`, `config.yml`).

### Changed
- **Rebranding & License Upgrade**: Removed all legacy Norganna references, URLs, and author credits across all `.toc`, `.lua`, and `.xml` files; rebranded suite to **Auctioneer Reforged** (`Author: gOOvER`, `Version: 1.0.0`) and upgraded the project license from GPLv2 to **GNU General Public License v3.0 (`GPL-3.0-or-later`)** (`LICENSE`, `GPL.txt`, `.toc` metadata, and source file headers).
- **Directory & Module Consolidation**: Consolidated 13 top-level folders down to 5 clean AddOn folders (`Auc-Advanced`, `Auc-ScanData`, `BeanCounter`, `Enchantrix`, `Informant`):
  - Embedded `Auc-Filter-Basic`, `Auc-Stat-Simple`, `Auc-Stat-Purchased`, `Auc-Stat-Histogram`, `Auc-Stat-StdDev`, `Auc-Stat-iLevel`, and `Auc-Util-FixAH` directly into `Auc-Advanced\Modules\` (`Active.xml` & `Auc-Advanced.toc`).
  - Integrated `Enchantrix-Barker` directly into `Enchantrix\Barker\` (`Enchantrix.toc`).
- **Modular Per-Language Localization (`Locales/<locale>.lua` & `Babylonian.lua` v4)**:
  - Split the 5 monolithic localization files (`CoreStrings.lua`, `BeanCounterStrings.lua`, `EnxStrings.lua`, `BarkerStrings.lua`, `InfStrings.lua`) into 84 modular per-locale files under `Auc-Advanced\Locales\`, `BeanCounter\Locales\`, `Enchantrix\Locales\`, `Enchantrix\Barker\Locales\`, and `Informant\Locales\` (`enUS.lua`, `deDE.lua`, etc.) loaded via `Locales\Load.xml`.
  - Automatically prunes all unused locale subtables on `PLAYER_LOGIN` (retaining only `GetLocale()`, `enUS`, and any user-configured locale) and frees the global `AuctioneerLocalizations`, `BeanCounterLocalizations`, `EnchantrixLocalizations`, `EnchantrixBarkerLocalizations`, and `InformantLocalizations` tables after ingestion (~80% RAM savings for locale strings).
- **Database & Price Cache Optimizations**:
  - Added a weak-valued `pricecache` (`{__mode="v"}`) to `Auc-Stat-Simple` (`StatSimple.lua`) to avoid repeated string splitting and variance recalculation during tooltip hovers and SearchUI evaluations.
  - Converted `pricecache` in `Auc-Stat-StdDev` (`StatStdDev.lua`) to a weak-valued table (`{__mode="v"}`) to prevent unbounded memory growth.
  - Added automatic pruning of empty/stale `serverKey` and item tables on initialization across `StatSimple.lua`, `StatPurchased.lua`, `StatHistogram.lua`, and `StatStdDev.lua`.
  - Removed synchronous `collectgarbage("collect")` on login in `Enchantrix\EnxStorage.lua` to eliminate login freezes.
- **Modernized Function Hooks**: Replaced all `Stubby.RegisterFunctionHook` calls with native `hooksecurefunc` and taint-free Lua closures across `Auc-Advanced`, `Auc-Util-SimpleAuction`, and `BeanCounter`.
- **Enchantrix Load Behavior**: Switched `Enchantrix` from `Stubby` bootcode `LoadOnDemand` to standard startup loading (`## LoadOnDemand: 0`, `## Dependencies: Auc-Advanced`).
- **Modernized Dark-Slate & Gold UI (`Gatherer Reforged` Design System)**:
  - Added `Configator.UIStyle` (`Auc-Advanced\Libs\Configator\Configator.lua` Minor 41) providing a unified flat dark-slate & gold design system (`UIStyle.ApplyBox`, `UIStyle.StyleWindow`, `UIStyle.StylePanel`, `UIStyle.StyleHeaderBar`, `UIStyle.StyleButton`, `UIStyle.StyleEditBox`) with crisp `1px` `WHITE8X8` borders, gold top header accents, and interactive hover/focus states.
  - Added live **UI Font Size (`10pt – 18pt`)** scaling (`A-` | `13pt` | `A+` buttons in `Configator` dialogs) and automatic button width fitting (`EnsureButtonTextFits`) across all styled buttons and checkboxes.
  - Redesigned `Configator` settings windows, category/tab sidebar navigation (with `2px` left gold selection indicator, compact `+`/`-` category toggles, and `19px` row height), gold section headers (`Header` / `Subhead`), compact flat `? Help` button, `18x18` checkboxes with clean vertical clearance, flat buttons (`"default"` / `"primary"`), and EditBox/MoneyFrame inputs (with `12x12` coin icons and right text insets).
  - Redesigned `ScrollSheet` (`Auc-Advanced\Libs\Configator\ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 24) with dark-slate header cells, a `1px` bottom gold accent bar, gold column titles, alternating horizontal row zebra stripes, and warm gold row selection highlights.
  - Redesigned `SelectBox` (`Auc-Advanced\Libs\Configator\SelectBox.lua` Minor 7) with left-aligned flat dark-slate dropdown inputs, integrated flat dropdown button, gold hover borders, and `18px`-row dark-gold context menus.
  - Applied the modern UI theme across `BeanCounter` (`BeanCounterFrames.lua`), `Appraiser` (`AprFrame.lua`), `SearchUI` (`SearchMain.lua`), `SimpleAuction` (`SimpFrame.lua`), `AutoMagic` (`Auc-Util-AutoMagic.lua`, `Mail-GUI.lua`, `ConfirmSellUI.lua`), `ScanButton` (`ScanButton.lua`), `BasicFilter` (`BasicFilter.lua`), `CoreBuy` (`CoreBuy.lua`), `Informant` (`InfMain.lua`), and `Enchantrix` (`EnxAutoDisenchant.lua`).
- **Modernized ColorPicker & Backdrop Support**: Updated `Configator.lua` to support Retail `ColorPickerFrame:SetupColorPickerAndShow` / `GetColorAlpha()` alongside legacy `ColorPickerFrame`, and guarded `BackdropTemplate` / `BackdropTemplateMixin` across `Informant`, `Enchantrix`, and `Enchantrix-Barker`.

### Fixed
- **Retail AuctionHouseFrame Tab Circular Anchor Crash (`Auc-Advanced/CoreUtil.lua`)**:
  - Removed custom tabs from `AuctionHouseFrame.Tabs` inside `lib.AddTab` (since `AuctionHouseFrameDisplayModeTabTemplate` uses `parentArray="Tabs"`, which caused `CreateFrame` to append custom tabs into `AuctionHouseFrame.Tabs` and made `PositionRetailTabs` anchor the first custom tab to the newly created custom tab, triggering `Action[SetPoint] failed because[Cannot anchor to a region dependent on it]` in `Appraiser`, `SearchUI`, and `SimpleAuction`).
  - Filtered `lastBuiltin` in `PositionRetailTabs` to ignore `_isCustomRetailTab` entries and cleared all custom tab points before re-anchoring.
- **Retail Load Blocker (`CoreManifest.lua`)**: Removed the `API_CHANGED = 80300` check that aborted loading on Retail clients (`tocVersion >= 80300`).
- **Classic Browse Search Crash (`CoreScan.lua`)**: Fixed `coremodule.Processors.auctionui()` saving `AuctionFrameBrowse_Update` while calling `private.Hook.AuctionFrameBrowse_Search()` (which was `nil`).
- **Invoice Operator Precedence Bug (`CoreScan.lua`)**: Fixed `if not invoiceType == 'seller'` and `if not invoiceType == 'buyer'` (which always evaluated to `false`) to `invoiceType ~= 'seller'` and `invoiceType ~= 'buyer'`, and scoped `ProcessInbox` as `local`.
- **Global Function Leak (`ScanData.lua`)**: Scoped `ChangeServerKey` properly as `function lib.ChangeServerKey(oldKey, newKey)`.
- **Tooltip Nil-String Crash (`CoreScan.lua`)**: Guarded `this.fontString[i][j]:GetText()` against `nil` before calling `string.lower()`.
- **`C_Container.GetContainerItemInfo` Table vs. Tuple Mismatch**: Unified `C_Container.GetContainerItemInfo` shims and callers across `CoreMain.lua`, `CorePost.lua`, `LibExtraTip_.lua`, `Auc-Util-AutoMagic`, `Auc-Util-SimpleAuction`, and `Enchantrix` so both table returns (Retail/modern Classic) and tuple returns (3.3.5/Forever) work without nil errors.
- **`ScrollSheet` Column Dragging Crash (`ScrollSheet.lua`)**: Added `GetTopMouseFocus()` helper supporting both `GetMouseFoci()` and `GetMouseFocus()` with safe nil/ID guards.
- **Retail `PostAuction` Argument Order (`CoreMain.lua`, `BeanCounter.lua`)**: Fixed argument order for `C_AuctionHouse.PostCommodity(itemLoc, duration, quantity, unitPrice)` and `C_AuctionHouse.PostItem(itemLoc, duration, quantity, minBid, buyoutPrice)`, and removed duplicate `PlaceAuctionBid`/`PostAuction` hook registrations in `BeanCounter.lua`.
- **Removed Global APIs (`CoreConst.lua`, `LibExtraTip_.lua`, `InfMain.lua`, `EnxMain.lua`, `EnxStorage.lua`)**: Added `C_Item`, `C_Spell`, `C_MerchantFrame`, and `Enum.ItemClass`/`Enum.InventoryType` fallbacks; replaced removed `OptionsButtonTemplate` with `UIPanelButtonTemplate`; fixed `NIL` global typos in `EnxMain.lua` and `EnxStorage.lua`; renamed `Informant.xml` close button from `TutorialFrameCloseButton` to `InformantFrameCloseButton`.
- **Stat & Filter Module Bugs**:
  - Fixed global variable leaks `IgnoreList` and `IgnoreLookup` in `BasicFilter.lua`.
  - Fixed broken `/auc stat purchased clear`, `/auc stat purchased push`, and `/auc stat ilevel clear` slash commands in `StatPurchased.lua` and `iLevel.lua`.
  - Fixed `DebugLib` shim in `CoreManifest.lua` to return a callable table with `:Dump()` support for `Enchantrix` and `Barker`.
- **AddOn Load Order & Circular `.toc` Dependency (`Auc-Advanced.toc`, `EnxMiniIcon.lua`, `Informant.xml`)**:
  - Removed `Informant, Enchantrix, BeanCounter` from `## OptionalDeps:` in `Auc-Advanced.toc` to break the circular dependency with `## Dependencies: Auc-Advanced`, ensuring `Auc-Advanced\Libs\Load.xml` (`Babylonian`, `Configator`, `nTipHelper:1`, `LibExtraTip_`) always loads before `BeanCounter`, `Enchantrix`, and `Informant`.
  - Added nil-safe localization and frame callback guards in `Enchantrix\EnxMiniIcon.lua` (`L(key)` fallback for `_ENCH`) and `Informant\Informant.xml` (`Informant.FrameLoaded` / `FrameActive` / `OnEvent` guards).
  - Initialized `AucAdvanced.EmbeddedModules` directly in `CoreManifest.lua` and moved the `<Script>` block to the top of `Modules\Active.xml` (with `ipairs(AucAdvanced.EmbeddedModules or {})` guards in `SearchMain.lua`, `AprFrame.lua`, `Auc-Util-AutoMagic.lua`, `ScanStart.lua`, and `CoreMain.lua`) so embedded modules checking `AucAdvanced.EmbeddedModules` at file load time never encounter `nil`.
- **Configator Layout, Scrolling & German (`deDE`) Localization (`Configator.lua` Minor 38, `SelectBox.lua` Minor 8, `PanelScroller.lua` Minor 6, `CoreSettings.lua`, `StatHistogram.lua`, `FlatOutlier.lua`, `OutlierFilter.lua`, `PriceLevel.lua`, `Locales/deDE.lua`)**:
  - Fixed controls overflowing the bottom border of settings panels by refining control vertical clearances (`Configator.lua`), enabling `SetClipsChildren(true)` on tab frames, and adding `gui:MakeScrollable(id)` to `Scanner`, `Data Maintenance`, `FlatOutlier`, `Outlier`, and `PriceLevel`.
  - Fixed `Selectbox` inline right-side label (`control.textEl`) overlapping the `[v]` dropdown arrow button on custom-width dropdowns (`Scanner` experimental settings).
  - Fixed `Histogram` (`StatHistogram.lua`) layout where the `Item Data Viewer` subhead overlapped the item slot and bargraph; anchored `frame.slot` and `frame.bargraph` dynamically below `viewerSubhead` and styled `frame.bargraph` with `UIStyle.ApplyBox`.
  - Moved `content.HelpButton` (`? Help`) leftwards (`x = -26`) so it never collides with the vertical scrollbar `upButton`.
  - Fixed language selection (`uselocale` / `SelectedLocale`) in `CoreSettings.lua` so the active client locale is displayed and saved properly, and added automatic `AucAdvanced.localizations` translation in `Configator` and `SelectBox` alongside complete German (`deDE`) translations for sidebar categories, tabs, `Scanner`, `Data Maintenance`, `Tooltip`, `Histogram`, `FlatOutlier`, `PriceLevel`, and `EasyBuyout`.
- **`ScrollSheet`, `PanelScroller`, `SelectBox`, `BeanCounter` & `SearchUI` Layout and `deDE` Localization (`Configator.lua` Minor 39, `ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 25, `SelectBox.lua` Minor 9, `PanelScroller.lua` Minor 7, `BeanCounterFrames.lua`, `BeanCounterTidyUp.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `Locales/deDE.lua`)**:
  - Fixed `ScrollSheet` column headers bleeding into the vertical scrollbar's `upButton` and missing horizontal scrollbars in `BeanCounter` and `SearchUI` by parenting `content` to `panel` (`ScrollFrame`), enabling `SetClipsChildren(true)` on `PanelScroller` with scrollbars parented to the outer container, setting horizontal scrollbar visibility to `"AUTO"`, and calling `self:Update()` in `calculateMaxScroll`.
  - Fixed `SelectBox` dropdown text being hidden behind `box`'s dark backdrop by creating `name.."Text"` on `box` (`OVERLAY` layer) and removing the conflicting `BOTTOMLEFT` anchor in `BeanCounterFrames.lua`.
  - Fixed `BeanCounter` sidebar checkbox overlap, skewed `resultlist` `TOPRIGHT` anchor, overlapping `Configure` button, and untranslated `UiUseDateFilter`, `Items:`, `Entries:`, `Configure`, and `month day year` labels.
  - Fixed `SearchUI` (`SearchMain.lua`) top `Saved searches:` bar (`gui.saves`) overlap, `tab.frame` FrameLevel bleed-through when attached to the Auction House, left sidebar tab overflow over the `Search` / `Clear` / `Cancel` buttons (added `gui.buttonBottom` clearance and mousewheel tab scrolling), and added German (`deDE`) translations for `SearchUI` controls, tabs, and tooltips.
- **`AutoMagic` UI Layout, Item Drop Slots, Button Sizing & `deDE` Localization (`Configator.lua` Minor 40, `Auc-Util-AutoMagic.lua`, `ConfirmSellUI.lua`, `Mail-GUI.lua`, `Locales/deDE.lua`, `Locales/enUS.lua`)**:
  - Added automatic minimum button width calculation and `SetText` hook in `UIStyle.StyleButton` so buttons created without explicit widths never clip or overflow their text labels.
  - Added `UIStyle.StyleItemSlot(slot, size)` to style item drop slots (`autosellframe.slot`, `CustomMailerFrame.slot`) as dark item-slot boxes instead of red `UIPanelButtonTemplate` buttons, with inset `0.08..0.92` item icon texcoords and gold hover borders.
  - Fixed skewed `TOPLEFT`/`TOPRIGHT` anchors on `autosellframe.baglist`, `autosellframe.resultlist`, `lib.confirmsellui.resultlist`, and `CustomMailerFrame.resultlist`, and sized/aligned all buttons and help labels across `autosellframe`, `ConfirmSellUI`, `Mail-GUI`, and `CustomMailerFrame`.
  - Localized all hardcoded `AutoMagic` titles, buttons, table headers, tooltips, and labels into German (`deDE`) and English (`enUS`).
- **Complete Codebase Localization (`enUS` & `deDE`) across All 5 AddOns & Submodules (`ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 26, `CoreBuy.lua`, `CorePost.lua`, `CoreMain.lua`, `AprFrame.lua`, `CompactUI.lua`, `ScanButton.lua`, `FilterItemPrice.lua`, `SearcherSnatch.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `SimpFrame.lua`, `InfTooltip.lua`, and all 5 `Locales/` directories)**:
  - Added automatic column header translation (`T(layout[i][1])` via `AucAdvanced.localizations`) in `ScrollSheet:Create` while preserving `label.origText` for locale-independent saved column widths in `SearchMain.lua` and `SimpFrame.lua`.
  - Wrapped all remaining hardcoded UI strings, prompts, buttons, and tooltips in `CoreBuy.lua`, `CorePost.lua`, `CoreMain.lua`, `AprFrame.lua`, `CompactUI.lua`, `ScanButton.lua`, `FilterItemPrice.lua`, `SearcherSnatch.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `SimpFrame.lua`, and `InfTooltip.lua` with `_TRANS` / `L(...)`, and styled `FilterItemPrice`, `SearcherSnatch`, and `SimpFrame` panels, item slots, editboxes, and buttons with `Configator.UIStyle`.
  - Synchronized 100% of locale keys between `enUS.lua` and `deDE.lua` across `Auc-Advanced`, `BeanCounter`, `Enchantrix`, `Enchantrix\Barker`, and `Informant` (0 missing keys) and added complete German (`deDE`) translations for all `Configator` controls, tabs, tooltips, help texts, SearchUI filters/searchers, `ItemSuggest`, `ScanStart`, `ScanFinish`, `SimpleAuction`, `VendMarkup`, `BeanCounter`, `Enchantrix-Barker`, and `Informant`.
- **Retail/Forever `AuctionHouseFrame` Tab Integration, Custom Tab Layouts & `Configator`/`Histogram` Fixes (`Configator.lua` Minor 42, `CoreUtil.lua`, `ScanButton.lua`, `SimpFrame.lua`, `AprFrame.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `BeanCounterFrames.lua`, `StatHistogram.lua`)**:
  - Guarded `lib.Settings.GetSetting("SelectedLocale")` in `CoreUtil.lua` (`lib.localizations`) with a `GetLocale()` fallback so `_TRANS(...)` calls during early file load (such as `CorePost.lua` before `CoreSettings.lua` loads) never fail with a nil call error.
  - Fixed `Configator` `anchorPoint` string arithmetic crash (`attempt to perform arithmetic on a string value`) when modules such as `ItemSuggest` pass `""` as `height` in `gui:AddControl(id, "Note", ...)`, and returned `el` from `"Header"` and `"Subhead"` controls.
  - Fixed `StatHistogram.lua` `FontString:SetPoint` circular anchor family connection error in WotLK/Forever clients by anchoring `frame.slot` directly to `frame` using `frame._estHeight` and setting explicit widths on `frame.name` and `frame.bargraph`.
  - Fixed `CoreUtil.lua` `AddTab` on Retail/Forever `AuctionHouseFrame` using `AuctionHouseFrameDisplayModeTabTemplate`, `PanelTemplates_TabResize(tab, 20, nil, 70)`, `PanelTemplates_SelectTab`/`PanelTemplates_DeselectTab`, and direct `TOPLEFT -> TOPRIGHT (3, 0)` anchoring after the last built-in tab (`Auktionen`), while hiding and restoring built-in `AuctionHouseFrame` child frames (`HideBuiltinAHContent` / `RestoreBuiltinAHContent`) and providing a unified opaque dark-slate surface (`EnsureTabFrameSurface`).
  - Fixed `BeanCounter` Auction House tab initialization (`CoreMain.lua`, `BeanCounter.lua`, `BeanCounterFrames.lua`) by setting `AucAdvanced.IsRetailAH = (C_AuctionHouse ~= nil)` at load time (even when an `AuctionFrame` alias exists), registering `BeanCounter` for the `auctionui` processor message, and ensuring left-clicking the `BeanCounter` tab always switches to `BeanCounterUiFrame`.
  - Added a bottom-right proportional window + content scale grip (`AucRetailAHResizer`, drag to scale window and 100% of internal content proportionally from `75%` to `175%` via `SetScale`, right-click to reset to `100%`, persisted in `core.general.ahWindowScale`) and top-bar font size controls (`[A-] [14pt] [A+]`, `AucRetailAHFontBar`) directly to `AuctionHouseFrame` (keeping `AuctionHouseFrame` at its native `800x538` geometry so Blizzard's `CategoriesList` and `BrowseResultsFrame` fill 100% of the window without empty space), applied proportional `SetScale` resizing to `BeanCounterBaseFrame.Resizer`, increased `Appraiser` item rows (`NUM_ITEMS = 14` on `IsRetailAH`) and hid the empty `AucAdvAppraiserCancelButton` when idle, and increased default font sizes and live `UIStyle` font scaling across `Configator` (Minor 43, default `14pt`), `ScrollSheet` (Minor 27, dynamic row allocation on vertical resize), `SelectBox` (Minor 10), `BeanCounter`, `Appraiser`, `SearchUI`, and `SimpleAuction`.
  - Repositioned `ScanButton` controls (`stop`, `play`, `pause`, `getall`, `count`) on `AuctionHouseFrame` into a compact group on the top-left of the title bar (`x = 68, y = -3`) so they no longer overlap the close/gear buttons or float in the center of the title bar.
  - Redesigned `SimpleAuction` (`SimpFrame.lua`) and `Appraiser` (`AprFrame.lua`) header/footer button anchoring and panel layouts so German and English buttons (`Clear Settings`/`Configure`, `Create Auction`/`Ignore`/`Refresh`/`Bid`/`Buy`, `Post items`/`Batch post`/`Refresh`) never overlap, and scaled `SearchUI` (`SearchMain.lua`) and `BeanCounter` (`BeanCounterFrames.lua`) cleanly to the `AuctionHouseFrame` content area.
  - Added `PriceLevel` percentage (`%`) indicators and colored gradient bars to all Retail/Forever `AuctionHouseFrame` result lists (`BrowseResultsFrame.ItemList`, `ItemBuyFrame.ItemList`, and `CommoditiesBuyFrame.ItemList` in `PriceLevel.lua`), enabled row colorizing by default (`util.pricelevel.colorize = true`), replaced removed `SetGradientAlpha` calls with a cross-version `ApplyBarGradient` helper (`SetGradient` + `CreateColor`), added smart peer/search fallback valuation when historical scan data is not yet present for an item, added `PriceLevel` row coloring to `SimpleAuction` (`SimpFrame.lua`), and populated `itemData[Const.IEQUIP]` in `CoreScan.lua` (`RetailBuildItemData`) for `Stat-iLevel`.
  - **Dynamic Window Resizing, Internal Content Reflow & Restored Original Features (`CoreUtil.lua`, `ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 28, `CoreScan.lua`, `CoreAPI.lua`, `ScanProgress.lua`, `SearchRealTime.lua`, `EasyBuyout.lua`, `Auc-Util-AHWindowControl.lua`, `AprFrame.lua`, `SimpFrame.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `BeanCounterFrames.lua`)**:
    - Added `AucAdvanced.ReflowRetailAHInternalFrames` (`CoreUtil.lua`) so dragging `AucRetailAHResizer` dynamically resizes `AuctionHouseFrame` (`800x538` to `1500x980`, with `Shift + Left-Drag` for `75%–175%` proportional `SetScale` and `Right-Click` to reset) and reflows Blizzard's `CategoriesList`, `BrowseResultsFrame`, `ItemBuyFrame`, `CommoditiesBuyFrame`, `ItemSellList`, `CommoditiesSellList`, and `AuctionsFrame` — stretching all background atlas textures (`auctionhouse-background-index` / `categories`), allocating additional `HybridScrollFrame` rows for taller windows, and recalculating `tableBuilder` column widths (`SetTableWidth`, `CalculateColumnSpacing`, `ArrangeHeaders`, `ArrangeCells`) across the full width.
    - Updated `ScrollSheet` (`ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 28) to proportionally stretch all visible columns to fill the available panel width when resized (while respecting manual user column resizes via `sheet.userResized`), replaced removed `SetGradientAlpha` calls with `ApplyRowGradient` (`SetGradient` + `CreateColor`) so colored rows render in `Appraiser`, `SearchUI`, `SimpleAuction`, and `BeanCounter`, and increased pre-allocated row height (`1400px`) for tall windows.
    - Matched custom bottom tabs (`BeanCounter`, `Appraiser`, `Suche`, `Einstellen`) in `CoreUtil.lua` to Blizzard's native `AuctionHouseFrame.Tabs` spacing, height, and selected/deselected state (`PanelTemplates_SelectTab` / `PanelTemplates_DeselectTab` without custom overlapping background boxes).
    - Restored targeted fast single-item/category browse scanning (`private.StartRetailBrowseScan` in `CoreScan.lua` via `C_AuctionHouse.SendBrowseQuery` + `RequestMoreBrowseResults` + `GetBrowseResults`) and `PopScan()` support on `IsRetailAH` so `Refresh` in `Appraiser` and `SimpleAuction` (`Post`), `Scan` in `Browse`, and queued scans run in ~1 second without any 15-minute `ReplicateItems` cooldown.
    - Restored `ScanProgress` textual progress overlay (`GetRetailProgressOverlay()` in `ScanProgress.lua`), styled `AucAdvanced.API.ProgressBars` (`CoreAPI.lua`) anchored above `AuctionHouseFrame`, enabled the `RealTimeSearch` (`RTS`) button and `RefreshPage()` (`SearchRealTime.lua`), enabled `EasyBuyout` `Right-Click` buyout/cancel on `AuctionHouseFrame` item and owned-auction lists (`EasyBuyout.lua`), and enabled `AHWindowControl` position saving/protection (`Auc-Util-AHWindowControl.lua`) on `IsRetailAH`.
    - Fixed `Appraiser` (`AprFrame.lua`) sidebar (`frame.manifest`) toggle in non-English locales (`frame.manifestOpen`), elevated sidebar `FrameStrata` (`HIGH`), added dynamic item slot scaling (`12` to `32` slots in `frame.itembox` on vertical resize), added `C_AuctionHouse.GetNumOwnedAuctions()` support for `Show own auctions`, and enlarged the `Buy`/`Bid` footer bar (`frame.imageview.purchase`).
    - Added the `Scan` button (`AucAdvScanButton`) to `AuctionHouseFrame.SearchBar`, `C_AuctionHouse.GetNumOwnedAuctions()` support in `private.GetMyPrice`, and `HandleModifiedItemClick` (`Alt+LeftClick`) support in `SimpleAuction` (`SimpFrame.lua`), and made `SearchUI` (`SearchMain.lua`) bottom action buttons (`Snatch`, `Ignore Price`, `Ignore`) scale responsively with the window width.
  - **Modern Dark-Slate & Gold Auction House Chrome, MoneyInputFrame Layout & `Appraiser` `GetItemCount` Fix (`Configator.lua` Minor 44, `ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 29, `CoreUtil.lua`, `AprFrame.lua`, `SimpFrame.lua`, `ScanButton.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `SearcherSnatch.lua`)**:
    - Replaced Blizzard's legacy `AuctionHouseFrame` `PortraitFrame` / `NineSlice` chrome (and the empty top-left circular portrait ring that overlapped module headers) with a taint-safe **Dark-Slate & Gold Auctioneer Window Shell** (`ahFrame._aucModernShell`), draggable top header bar (`ahFrame._aucDragBar`), dark-slate skinned built-in subframes (`CategoriesList`, `SearchBar`, `BrowseResultsFrame`, `ItemBuyFrame`, `CommoditiesBuyFrame`, `ItemSellFrame`, `AuctionsFrame`, `MoneyFrameBorder`), and unified modern bottom tabs (`StyleModernAHTab`) with a `2px` gold top bar on the active tab.
    - Fixed `AprFrame.lua:1624: attempt to call a nil value` (`GetItemCount` nil in WoW 11.x/12.x/Forever and called with an Auctioneer `sig`) by adding `GetSigItemCount(sig)` backed by `AucAdvanced.Post.CountAvailableItems(sig)` and `C_Item.GetItemCount`.
    - Fixed `AucRetailAHFontBar` (`[A-] 13pt [A+]`) and `Configator` font buttons expanding to `46px` and overlapping the settings gear icon by honoring `btn._fixedWidth` in `UIStyle.StyleButton` (`EnsureButtonTextFits`) and anchoring the font bar right-to-left at `("TOPRIGHT", ahFrame, "TOPRIGHT", -54, -4)`.
    - Added `UIStyle.StyleMoneyInputFrame(moneyFrame, goldWidth, silverWidth)` and updated `UIStyle.StyleEditBox` to detect modern `box.icon` coin textures, right-align coin editboxes with `SetTextInsets(4, 18, 0, 0)`, and space `Gold`, `Silver`, and `Copper` fields cleanly across `SimpleAuction`, `Appraiser`, `SearchUI`, `SearcherSnatch`, and `Configator`.
    - Updated `ScrollSheet` (`ScrollSheet.lua` Minor 29) so non-user-resized columns expand to fit their localized header text (`minHdrW = strW + 14`) and inset the sorted column header text by `-12px` so the yellow sort arrow never overlaps German headers (`Kauf/S.`, `Mindestgeb...`, `Sofortka...`).
    - Increased `Appraiser` left item list (`frame.itembox`) row height to `30px` (`31px` stride), enabled `SetClipsChildren(true)`, recalculated `NUM_ITEMS` dynamically in `SetScroll()` and `OnSizeChanged`, and dynamically anchored the `Zeige: [ ] Versteckt [ ] Auktionen` filter bar so it never collides with `frame.salebox`.
  - **Modern AH Tabs, Dedicated `%` Column, Sortable Columns, Full-Window Modal Scan Blocker & `BeanCounter`/`SearchUI` Layout Fixes (`Configator.lua` Minor 45, `CoreUtil.lua`, `PriceLevel.lua`, `ScanProgress.lua`, `BeanCounterFrames.lua`, `SearchMain.lua`, `Locales/deDE.lua`)**:
    - Fixed `private.relevelFrame` / `private.relevelFrames` (`CoreUtil.lua`) so child frame relative elevations are preserved (`curLevel < minLevel`) instead of flattening all children to the same `FrameLevel`, and replaced child `Frame` overlays on built-in `AuctionHouseFrame` panels with low-sublevel `BACKGROUND` textures (`ApplyLowBackgroundBox`) so `CategoriesList`, `ItemList`, and `MoneyFrame` are never covered.
    - Fixed bottom AH tabs (`StyleModernAHTab`, `SetRetailTabChecked`, `ResizeRetailTab`, `SyncBuiltinRetailTabStates` in `CoreUtil.lua`) so all tab titles (`Kaufen`, `Verkaufen`, `Auktionen`, `BeanCounter`, `Appraiser`, `Suche`, `Einstellen`) render on a dedicated `box._label` (`OVERLAY`) in bright gold/white without being dimmed by `PanelTemplates_DeselectTab` or truncated to `Ap...`, `Su...`, `Ein...`.
    - Styled all remaining legacy Blizzard `AuctionHouseFrame` buttons (`CloseButton`, `CancelAuctionButton`, `BuyoutButton`, `BidButton`, `PostButton`, `BackButton`, `SearchButton`, `FilterButton`, `FavoritesSearchButton`, and `RefreshButton` across all views), `AuctionsFrame` top sub-tabs (`Auktionen` / `Gebote`, preserving `AuctionsTab`'s native `AuctionsFrame` anchor to avoid a circular dependency with `SummaryList`), and `HeaderContainer` column headers (`StyleRetailHeaderButton` / `StyleRetailHeaderContainer`).
    - Separated `Verfügbar` and `%` into two distinct columns (`PriceLevel.lua`, `CoreUtil.lua`) with a dedicated `55px` `"%"` header button (`_aucPctHeaderBtn` parented to `itemList` directly above the `%` column and `HeaderContainer`'s `TOPRIGHT` inset by `56px`), a `SetTableWidth` clamp on `itemList.tableBuilder`, a `1px` vertical column divider on each row, and ascending/descending click-sorting (`InstallSortableDataProvider` wrapping the 2nd `getEntry` parameter of `AuctionHouseItemListMixin:SetDataProvider`, `SetupHeaderButtonsSorting`, `SortRetailItemListByColumn`) on **every** column (`Preis`, `Gegenstand`, `St.`, `Verfügbar`, `%`, `Gebotspreis`, `Kaufpreis`, `Restzeit`).
    - Added live seller name (`Verkäufer`) resolution in `CoreScan.lua` (`StartRetailBrowseScan` via `C_AuctionHouse.SendSearchQuery` + `GetCommoditySearchResultInfo` / `GetItemSearchResultInfo`) and automatic background seller backfilling in `Appraiser` (`AprFrame.lua` via `C_AuctionHouse.GetOwnedAuctionInfo` + `C_AuctionHouse.SendSearchQuery` when inspecting items scanned via `ReplicateItems`), and replaced the bright additive yellow selection highlight in `Appraiser`'s item list with a clean dark-gold `BLEND` selection bar.
    - Styled `BrowseRTSButton` (RealTime Search toggle in `SearchRealTime.lua`) with `Configator.UIStyle.StyleButton` and anchored it to the right of `AucScanButtonBar.count` (`+8px`) with German (`deDE`) tooltip text so it never overlaps the `"0"` scan counter.
    - Rebuilt `GetRetailProgressOverlay()` (`ScanProgress.lua`) as a full-window modal input blocker (`DIALOG` strata, `FrameLevel 185`, `EnableMouse(true)`, `EnableMouseWheel(true)`) covering the entire `AuctionHouseFrame` (including bottom tabs and top buttons) with a centered dark-slate & gold status card and German (`deDE`) localization.
    - Removed the top-right `[A-] 12pt [A+]` font bar (`AucRetailAHFontBar`) from `AuctionHouseFrame` and standardized default UI font size to `12pt`.
    - Fixed `BeanCounter` (`BeanCounterFrames.lua`) left sidebar (`frame.sidebarPanel`, `206px` width), item drop help label (`frame.slot.help`), and checkbox label widths (`168px`) so text never overflows onto `frame.searchBox` or `frame.resultlist`.
    - Fixed `SearchUI` (`SearchMain.lua`, `Configator.lua` Minor 45) sidebar `FrameLevel` ordering (`gui.buttons` above `frame.backing`), non-overlapping top config panel (`tab.frame`) and bottom results table (`gui.frame`), sidebar `Suche` / `Leeren` buttons, dedicated bottom footer bar (`Kaufen`, `Später`, `Sofortkauf`, `Gebot`, `Preis ignor.`, `Ignorieren`, `Schnapper`), and German (`deDE`) translations for `Reason`, `Bid/ea`, `Buy/ea`, `Min/ea`, `Cur/ea`, and the `About` tab.

### Removed
- Deleted legacy standalone addons and libraries: `!Swatter`, `Stubby`, `SlideBar`, `DebugLib`, and `LibRevision`, as well as the illegal `..\Auc-Advanced\Libs\Load.xml` relative path in `Informant.toc`.
- Deleted empty top-level `Auc-Match-Undercut` folder, developer template modules (`Auc-Stat-Example2`, `Auc-Util-Example`), and redundant `.toc` files inside embedded `Libs` and `Modules` subdirectories.

### Security
- Eliminated `loadstring` usage in `CoreConfig.lua` (replaced with `_G["SLASH_AUCADVANCED"..pos]`) and removed `Stubby` dynamic `loadstring` function wrappers and SavedVariables bootcode execution.
- Sandboxed `loadstring(rope)` in `Auc-ScanData\ScanData.lua` using `setfenv(loader, {})` prior to `pcall(loader)`.
- Added WoW 12.x `<secret string>` (`issecretvalue`) guards on chat and UI error event handlers in `CoreScan.lua`, `BidMonitor.lua`, and `EnxMain.lua`.
